##### Project general facts

The View Island, nestled within the Ajmal Makan City enclave, delivers a collection of residences that include Aryam Villas, Perla Townhouses and Alba Townhouses, each crafted to satisfy a discerning appetite for comfort. The development embraces a contemporary layout that frames expansive sea vistas while fostering a sense of openness throughout the home. Architectural intent focuses on seamless indoor‑outdoor flow, highlighted by generous balconies that invite the coastal breeze.

First‑class amenities animate the community, featuring a central lagoon that mirrors the surrounding waters and an urban beach designed for leisurely strolls. A welcoming clubhouse offers a hub for social gatherings, while a network of parks scattered across the site provides tranquil green pockets for relaxation. The pristine sea serves as a constant backdrop, enriching everyday moments with its calming presence.

Modern finishing with high-quality materials defines the interior ambience, establishing a refined yet welcoming tone. Kitchens arrive fully equipped, ready to support effortless culinary pursuits. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to infuse personal style at will. 

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamriyah presents a charming coastal district in Sharjah, celebrated for its serene lagoon that glistens beneath the sun. Residents can wander along the beautiful public beach, indulging in leisurely walks and a variety of water‑sport activities while taking in sweeping Arabian Gulf panoramas. The atmosphere blends relaxed seaside living with an inviting sense of community.

The neighborhood supplies essential conveniences through a collection of grocery stores that meet daily needs and mosques that anchor cultural traditions. Recreational facilities dot the area, encouraging an active lifestyle for families and individuals alike. Easy access to urban amenities ensures that everyday requirements are met without compromising the tranquil setting.

Proximity to Hamriyah Port and the adjoining Free Zone opens doors to robust business prospects and seamless connections to global markets. The locale’s spacious villas and laid‑back rhythm provide a soothing retreat from the faster pace of city life. Despite the peaceful environment, essential services and popular attractions remain within convenient reach.
